language.description: The first Summary version is always English.

title.description:
Document title: - AI Summary. The initiative title excludes 3Sigma/Trisigma links, URLs, source-link annotations, defense stage or request labels, document language labels, and literal or escaped HTML line breaks (such as
before Gate 2).

versions.description: Exactly two complete Summary versions: English first, Russian second.

context.description: Up to six complete, readable sentences explaining the initiative, problem, target product, stage and past pilots. Apply the skill's terminology glossary.

required_elements.description: The exact stage checklist, in canonical order. Do not add criteria from other stages.

critical_problems.description: Zero to ten source-grounded problems not covered, even indirectly, by required elements. Do not paraphrase duplicate facts or report spreadsheet parsing errors such as REF/NAME. Each has one short issue sentence and a concrete supporting fact or comparison with enough context to understand the figures; no recommendations.

issue.description: One short sentence stating a significant problem. Never report spreadsheet extraction errors such as #REF or #NAME here. Renderers make this text bold; do not include Markdown formatting.

fact.description: One or two short source-grounded sentences explaining the fact behind the problem. Include the relevant before/after figures, periods, and source section when available in Gate Challenger or IC Review, rather than a vague claim or unexplained number. Do not infer a new finding from raw document text.

periods.description: Shared periods for all four metrics. Last column is always Total. Start at the later common year and use matching granularity, preserving later years with dashes for unavailable metrics. Label any DTB H2-only value explicitly in its annual cell. Prefer the explicitly marked current-scenario horizon in the source table (including FAQ 3) over a similar Total from another scenario or appendix; never relabel a 2026-2030 Total as 2027-2031.

rows.description: Four rows in fixed order. Revenue rows must come from income, never CoS/COGS/Cost of Sales or another expense section, regardless of row name. Each values array follows periods exactly; missing metrics use dashes. If Revenue non-DTB is entirely absent, copy each sourced Total Revenue value only into an empty Revenue from DTB cell whose period also has cumulative DTB. Copy the Total column only when DTB covers every shown year with sourced Total Revenue. Never copy when cumulative DTB is absent; never replace sourced Revenue from DTB values.

values.description: Values must be in the same order as periods. Every missing or unextractable value is an em dash (—), never an explanatory phrase or a short hyphen. Total values must be explicitly sourced for the shown horizon, not recomputed.

mismatch_periods.description: Only for Total Revenue: periods whose sourced total is proven unequal to the sum of sourced Revenue from DTB and Revenue non-DTB, in the same units and scenario. The renderer colors those total cells red.

status.description: Use есть/частично подтверждено/нет. Gate 2 hypotheses and Stream Review 1 solution checks may use a technical numerator/denominator; visible headings always count detail.items verdicts instead of showing the fraction when items exist. Gate 2 and Stream Review 1 metric linkage is есть only when at least 80 percent of listed input/output metrics have confirmed binding. For Progress Review next-half-year plan, outputs and metrics must both be nonempty for есть; one nonempty group means частично подтверждено, neither means нет. For Progress Review and Stream Review 2+ plan-vs-actual, apply the same rule to launches and metrics, regardless of whether individual launch targets were met. If the model omits structured detail, retain the Gate Challenger evidence status rather than treating extraction failure as absence.

evidence.description: One to three short source-grounded sentences in natural language; prefer fewer. For stop criteria, describe the strongest explicit stopping criterion and whether it is clearly defined, with the remaining criteria in detail.criteria.

detail.description: Structured details displayed immediately below this required element, not in Appendices.

items.description: List confirmed items first, then insufficient items. Gate 2 and Stream Review 1 visible headings count this array. The heading label before the colon is bold; the counts after the colon are regular weight.

text.description: For Gate 2 hypotheses and Stream Review 1 solution checks, one concise sentence per item, including why it is confirmed or insufficiently confirmed. No separate test/expected/actual paragraphs. Do not repeat the localized verdict in text.

metric_binding_detail.description: Deduplicate metrics across both lists before counting. The heading displays X confirmed and Z insufficiently confirmed out of Y displayed metrics, X+Z=Y, not a colored overall verdict. Do not invent counts for empty lists.

metric.description: Metric name without measurement units or Markdown. Rendered bold, followed by regular evidence and then the colored binding status on the same flowing line.

binding.description: Relevance to the product/problem/UTP, not empirical validation or attainment of the metric target. A theoretically relevant metric can have confirmed binding even without a completed test.

evidence.description: One source-grounded sentence explaining relevance to the problem/UTP. Display after the metric name, before the binding status, without bold or a forced line break.

next_review_plan_detail.description: For Progress Review, at least one output and one metric plan make the required element present. Only one populated group is partial; neither is missing. This does not assess plan quality.

next_review.description: Target value with the next review date or quarter when supplied by the source.

primary_criterion.description: The strongest explicit stopping criterion, without commentary. Empty if absent. Also describe it and its clarity in the parent evidence. Presence means present even if wording is unclear; never call it stop-loss. Do not infer a stopping rule from traction deviation alone.

criteria.description: Additional stopping criteria only, with semantic duplicates of the primary and each other removed. Empty when there are none. Only a nonempty list gets the Additional stop criteria heading.
Gate 3 product-market fit criteria, displayed as a numbered list.

plan_fact_detail.description: For Progress Review and Stream Review 2+, nonempty launches and metrics groups make the required element present; one populated group is partial, neither is missing. A not_completed launch still counts as a documented plan-vs-actual row.

status.description: Progress Review launch result: green, orange, red, or neutral respectively in web/PDF/Word. Do not color the output or comment.

source_links_detail.description: Select mockup/video/design links only by source label and context, without opening targets. At least one verified relevant source link makes Gate 2 user flow present. Render links blue.

source_link_id.description: Preferred model output: exact id from source_document.links for a relevant mockup, video, product design or user flow (often FAQ 1). The server resolves it to the exact original URL before saving. Hidden/anonymized URLs do not mean unavailable.

url.description: Exact URL copied from the source document. Never construct or guess URLs.
